The asset never enters CloakLLM (the caller passes a content hash).","deployer_responsibility":"Actually label or watermark the generated content and disclose it to users. CloakLLM records that you did; it does not perform the labeling itself.","status":"record_keeping_only","title":"Transparency and content labeling"}],"disclaimer":"CloakLLM provides the record-keeping, evidence, and PII-minimization slice of the articles below.
